verdict: Meta is delivering; Google Search spend needs to be addressed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all 30 of your leads came from Meta at a cost of $52.66 per lead — a 160% jump in leads week-over-week and a 56% drop in cost per lead. Google Search, by contrast, spent $2,474.74 over the same window and produced 2 conversions, a cost of roughly $1,237 per lead with no sign of improvement. We are actively reviewing Google Search budget allocation to stop that drain and redirect resources toward what is working. Separately, your pipeline shows 30 leads arrived this period with no appointments recorded, which points to an intake routing issue we are working to close. Next week you should see a cleaner Google picture and a first look at whether pipeline progression improves.
